Utah Revokes License of Boarding School Where Abuse Allegations Persist

The state of Utah has revoked the license of a boarding school where socialite Paris Hilton said she was abused as a teenager. The decision comes after decades of abuse allegations against the school. Paris Hilton's statement claims the school 'failed the children in its care'. The revocation is part of an ongoing effort to address the school's history of abuse.
